title: 駆け抜けろ、お弁当作り！

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And the finishing touch is to put in your favorites… Okay, done.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Incredible! Carrot Ranger sausages and Carrot Ranger hamburger steaks!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It's jam-packed with foods I love! I can't wait to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, tomorrow's picnic is going to be so exciting. All that's left is Akebono's…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Phew… That's the twelfth layer complete. …It looks like this is still going to take a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Flower and Biko, you should both turn in for the night! I'll go to bed when I'm done with my twenty-layer Buono Sumo Stew lunchbox!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A true hero never abandons her friends! And remember—we're sprinters! Our combined speed should make short work of this lunchbox!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You're right. If we divide up the tasks, we'll be able to finish quickly enough that it won't affect our schedule!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Thank you both!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Akebono, you just focus on cooking. And don't worry about how big things get.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can adjust the portions by arranging the food, and I'll divide up anything that doesn't fit into the boxes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's cook up some buono food!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Biko, please pass Akebono the ingredients she asks for while making sure the extra portions I set aside find their way into the fridge!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! I'll move as quickly as Carrot Ranger Turbo in Speed Mode!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay, here we go! Pound some meat! Crack the pepper! Shake-shake-shake the salt! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Stuff it into the boxes, wrap up the extras aaand… Here, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Carrot Boost full power! Yah, yah, yah, yah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the picnic arrives…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I think it's about time for lunch! I'm starving after all that walking.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And thanks to you two, I completed the upgraded thirty-layer buono chanko lunchbox! Go ahead and eat your fill! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Here's your specially requested Carrot Ranger lunchbox, Biko.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Excellent! It's chow time! One, two…

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Dig iiiin! ♪
